idea: Move every size-zero padding square off the interior. The current code puts them at (0.5,0.5), which lies inside a real square whenever k is odd, and a strict evaluator may count that as a shared interior point. Place them instead at distinct boundary corners or grid-line vertices, such as (0,0), (1,0) and points of the form (i/k, 0), which are never interior to any square.
